units.source_text: 大堰邸内的人，怀念小女公子，终无已时。

en.t: The people at the Oi residence missed the little young lady without end.

units.source_text: 明石姬越发痛悔自己的错失了。

en.t: Lady Akashi felt still deeper remorse over her own mistake.

units.source_text: 尼姑母夫人那天虽然如此教训女儿，现在也不免常常流泪。

en.t: Although her nun mother had admonished her daughter so firmly that day, she too could not help shedding tears often now.

units.source_text: 但闻那边如此爱惜这小女公子，心中也自欢欣。

en.t: Yet when she heard that they cherished the little young lady so tenderly there, she was also glad at heart.

units.source_text: 小女公子身上，那边供奉周到，此间不须操心。

en.t: As for the little young lady, she was cared for perfectly there, so this household had no need to worry.

units.source_text: 只是备办了许多色彩非常华美的衣服，送给乳母以及小女公子贴身的众侍女。

en.t: They merely prepared many robes of exceptionally beautiful colors and sent them to the nurse and to the young lady's close attendant women.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想起：若久不去访，明石姬定会疑心：果如所料，从今我抛弃她了，因而更加恨我，这倒对她不起。

en.t: Prince Genji thought that if he went a long time without visiting, Lady Akashi would surely suspect that, just as she had feared, he had abandoned her from now on, and would hate him all the more; that would be unfair to her.

units.source_text: 于是在年内某日悄悄地前往访问了一次。

en.t: So on a certain day before the year ended, he quietly went to visit her once.

units.source_text: 邸内本已非常岑寂，再加失去了那朝夕宝爱的孩子，其悲伤可想而知。

en.t: The residence had already been very lonely, and now that they had lost the child they treasured morning and night, their grief was easy to imagine.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想到这里，也觉得痛苦，因此不绝地去信慰问。

en.t: When Prince Genji thought of this, he too felt pained, and therefore kept sending letters of comfort and inquiry.

units.source_text: 紫姬如今也不甚妒恨明石姬了。

en.t: Lady Murasaki, too, no longer felt much jealousy or resentment toward Lady Akashi now.

units.source_text: 看这可爱的孩子面上，饶恕了她的母亲。

en.t: For the sake of this adorable child, she forgave the child's mother.
